name: timed-original-audit
cmd: bun f3-input/audit-pilot.ts pilot-input/f3-timed-numeric-mldr.log --strict-window --require-timed-window; bun numeric-input/pilot-source.ts pilot-input/f3-timed-numeric-mldr.log

name: strict-timing-rejection-control
cmd: set -euo pipefail; if bun f3-input/audit-pilot.ts rejected-input/f3-timed-numeric-mldr.log --strict-window --require-timed-window > rejected-audit.log 2>&1; then printf 'unexpected acceptance of invalid original timestamps\n'; exit 1; fi; grep -F 'valid sample timestamps are required' rejected-audit.log; printf 'F3_INVALID_TIMING_REJECTED\n'

name: timed-source-stack-map
cmd: bun recovery-input/materialize.ts && bun recovery-input/compose.ts numeric && bun f3-input/map-timed-stack.ts
